$comment: Each region is built independently by `npm run data -- <id>`. A feature belongs to a region when its centroid lies inside `boundary` (lon/lat ring) and, if `borough` is set, the nearest NYC borough to it is that borough. Keep region boundaries non-overlapping so features are never duplicated.

regions.name: Lower Manhattan
regions.description: Manhattan south of Houston Street (SoHo, Tribeca, LES, Chinatown, FiDi, Battery Park City, Governors/Liberty/Ellis Islands)
